caseName: Garnett ex rel. Smith v. Renton School District No. 403
caseNameFull: Garnett, by and Through his Next Friend, Smith v. Renton School District No. 403

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Westside Community Bd. of Ed. v. Mergens, ante, p. 226.

Justice Stevens dissents.
